messages:
ops-bot: nightly-ci alert — small-batch p95 tail latency +32% vs baseline for model 'redwood-44b-quant' on runner pool 'nightly-smoke'. job: nightly/perf/small-batch. check run: https://perf.redwood/inv/XY12
eli: seeing the alert, pinging from home — anyone oncall? :eyes:
maria: i'm up, looking at the job now. which commit range?
jun: alert started ~ 04:12 UTC, looks correlated with a kernel update landed in main around 03:50 (commit a3f7c9). could be scheduling changes.
sarah: i can try a quick repro locally with the same kernel. can you dump the failing job logs?
maria: grabbing logs, will paste the tail. minimal noise first.
maria: ```
[2026-03-17T04:12:07Z] request_id=nightly-1287 p95=410ms p50=70ms batch=4 seq=512
[2026-03-17T04:12:08Z] request_id=nightly-1287 worker=runner-18 kernel=5.18.12-rt latency_tail=412ms
[2026-03-17T04:12:09Z] request_id=nightly-1287 worker=runner-21 kernel=5.19.1 latency_tail=415ms
```
ben: runner-21 having slightly higher tail, but both up. not seeing OOM or retries. no code changes in model serving.
eli: can someone kick a profiling run with --sample-mode=tail and capture flamegraph? if we get stack samples we can see scheduler vs syscall waits.
jun: scheduled a job: `perf-run --suite=nightly-smallbatch --commit=a3f7c9..main --profile=flame --samples=10 --batch=4 --seq=512` — link: https://ci.redwood/run/8442 (queued)
sarah: i'll ssh into runner-21 and attach perf top while the job runs. sharing my terminal: ssh sarah@runner-21
maria: quick check: is KV cache warm? on small-batch tests we sometimes see warmup variance. logs show cache hit rate ~99% so probably not that.
ben: also checking network IRQ distribution, saw a small spike in softirqs after kernel update earlier today. could be noisy interrupts.
eli: if perf points to futex or irq handlers we should roll back kernel on a staging pool and re-run. let's collect flamegraph first.
maria: profiling job finished, flamegraph link: https://perf.redwood/inv/FLMG-8442. major stacks show a spike in `softirq_work` and `__do_softirq` during tail windows.
jun: that aligns with the kernel change notes (deferred softirq scheduling tweak). good find.
sarah: repro on runner-21 with older kernel (5.18.11) shows p95 back to baseline (~310ms). can confirm rollback mitigates.
eli: plan: 1) pin nightly runners to 5.18.11 for small-batch pool; 2) open rollback change for the kernel update in staging; 3) follow up with infra to evaluate kernel patch. who wants the rollout PR?
maria: i'll open the PR to pin config and notify infra for rollout. assign to @ben to review.
ben: ack, will review within the hour. also adding a note to perf alerts to treat softirq deltas as a signal for kernel-level regressions. :memo:
eli: thanks all. please update this thread with PR link and when the pin is live. if rollback is blocked we'll schedule an oncall window. :thumbsup:
maria: PR created: https://git.redwood/platform-config/pulls/172 — pins nightly-smoke pool to 5.18.11, adds rollback doc. marking for urgent merge.
ops-bot: deploy pipeline started for config/nightly-smoke pinned-kernel-172 (staging).
jun: monitoring post-deploy. early numbers look better, p95 trending down.
sarah: will run a 3-hour smoke to be safe. reply here if you see anything odd.
eli: great job team — clean root cause and mitigation path. logging this for postmortem notes. :rocket:
